messages.content: 請問4567和7890這兩個數字的質因數是什麼？能否提供格式化的字串和陣列形式？

function.name: get_prime_factors
function.description: Function to retrieve prime factors of a number. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

number.description: Number for which prime factors need to be calculated

formatted.description: Return formatted string if true, array if false

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "請問4567和7890這兩個數字的質因數是什麼？能否提供格式化的字串和陣列形式？" They want prime factors of 4567 and 7890, both formatted string and array forms.

We have a tool get_prime_factors that takes number and formatted boolean. We can call it twice: once for each number with formatted true and once with formatted false? Actually we can call it separately for each number and specify formatted true or false. But the function returns either formatted string or array depending on formatted flag. So we can call get_prime_factors(number=4567, formatted=true) to get formatted string for 4567. Then get_prime_factors(number=4567, formatted=false) to get array. Similarly for 7890.

But maybe we can combine calls? The function signature expects one number at a time. So we need separate calls.

Thus we will call get_prime_factors twice per number. That is four calls total. But we might also do two calls: one for each number with formatted true, then one for each number with formatted false. Or we could do separate calls for each combination.

We should produce output: For 4567: formatted string and array; For 7890: formatted string and array.

We need to use the function calls. We'll call get_prime_factors for 4567 formatted true, then for 4567 formatted false, then for 7890 formatted true, then for 7890 formatted false.

We'll output the results accordingly.
